messages:
sophia: Re: PRD check-in for project-scoped API keys + RBAC. We need to lock scope, acceptance criteria, and migration constraints by EOW. Customer asks are piling up (fintech + health).

tanvi: short version: customers want per-project API keys (so dev/test/live separation), role-based permissions on keys, and audit logs with rotation TTLs. They also asked for least-privilege templates.

lee: Q: do we intend to reuse the scoped tokens work from last year or design a fresh API-key-first model? Reuse reduces infra churn but the UX surface differs (tokens vs API keys).

mike: +1 for API-key-first. Implementation sketch: API keys are first-class resources tied to org and an optional project list. Token machinery can mint short-lived tokens off keys for service-to-service use. Example request:
```
POST /v1/api-keys
{
  "name": "invoice-svc-key",
  "org_id": "org_abc",
  "projects": ["proj_invoices"],
  "roles": ["inference:invoke", "datastore:write"],
  "ttl_days": 90
}
```
Would cover the major asks.

anna: Security constraints: must enforce KMS-backed key material, rotation API, and immutable audit trail for creation/permission changes. Also need approval flow for org-wide keys.

lee: acceptance criteria draft (high level):
- create/read/delete API for keys with org/project scoping
- RBAC enforcement for key ops and ability to attach role lists to keys
- audit events for create/rotate/delete with actor id
- runtime enforcement: requests using a key are authorized to the intersection of key roles + project membership
- migration path: existing scoped-tokens continue to work for 6 months and we provide a migration tool

mike: edge cases: what happens if a project is deleted but keys reference it? Suggest keys silently drop deleted projects but keep a tombstone in audit. Also consider wildcard project scopes (org-wide) and service accounts.

tanvi: product prioritization: customers that asked are willing to pay for dedicated support / expedited SLAs. Recommend milestone split: M1 core CRUD + enforcement + audits, M2 rotation & KMS integration, M3 UI templates + migration assistant + enterprise policies.

sophia: launch criteria proposal:
- all core APIs implemented and e2e tested
- RBAC rules tested with canary customers (2 customers)
- audit logs flowing to customer S3/Kinesis for Private/Dedicated customers and to our retention store for hosted
- documentation and quickstart samples for 3 common patterns (service account, per-project dev keys, org-wide read-only)

lee: rollout strategy: canary on Dedicated and a small set of Hosted customers with opt-in flag + compatibility layer for legacy scoped tokens. Fail-open? No — must fail-closed for auth checks.

infra-bot: rfc-draft created: https://rfc.redwood.mock/r/1234 - PRD / API examples attached.

mike: implementation notes: runtime needs a fast key lookup keyed by api_key_id -> roles + projects. We should keep policy evaluation O(1) per request (no DB join in hot path). Caching TTL ~ 30s with invalidation hooks on key update.

anna: logging must include key_id, actor, org_id, project_id, invoked_action, decision (allow/deny), and decision_reasons. Also add a high-volume detection alert for suspicious key usage.

lee: open questions for PRD:
- exact semantics for overlapping project lists (union vs intersection with caller project)
- whether to allow role inheritance or role templates vs explicit roles
- API-level vs model-level permissions (do we need fine-grained model ops like model:reroute)

tanvi: product decision proposals:
- default semantics: key projects = union; caller must be in at least one project in key.projects to use (reason: simpler UX)
- support role-templates (admin, inference-invoke, metrics-read) for M2
- expose model-level roles later (M3) unless enterprise asks force earlier

sophia: next steps / owners:
- lee: finalize auth semantics + write RFC on edge cases (due Tue)
- mike: prototype in runtime for key lookup + cache (POC by Thu)
- anna: draft audit & KMS requirements (due Wed)
- tanvi: update PRD prioritization and external comms (customer-facing change log) (due Fri)

mike: FYI: quick hack to create a scoped test key locally:
```
redis-cli set api_key:local:abc123 '{"org":"org_abc","projects":["proj_x"],"roles":["inference:invoke"]}'
```
Not for prod, just helpful for dev validation.

sophia: thanks all — I'll sync with sales on which customers to pick for canary and paste names here. If anyone objects to the rollout plan, flag here. :thumbsup:

lee: ack. I'll start the RFC draft and ping infra for storage sizing.

anna: added note — require MFA for UI key creation that grants org-wide roles.

sophia: closing: please keep thread updates concise. We'll do a follow-up all-hands for the roadmap once RFC is stable.
